reviewer: Codex; one isolated medium mathematical reviewer

claims.summary: Over a perfect field of odd characteristic p, the root-polynomial space V_d has injective p^(-1)-semilinear maps D_r(sum w_S P_S)=sum w_S Gamma_r(P_S R_(S-complement)^((p-1)/2)) into V_floor((d+(p-1)n-2r)/p). Reconstruction is R^((p-1)/2) f=sum_r T^r D_r(f)^p; exact characterwise divisibility and degree constraints describe the image. All marked length-N kernels correspond to component lengths ceil((N-r)/p), with the image retained. For n>=2,d>=n-2 the image codimension is (p-1)n2^(n-2); if the required lower jet maps are onto, original normality is equivalent to a compatibility map of that size. Target degrees contract for d>n. No general invertibility is asserted.
claims.assessment: Working self-contained polynomial proof from Frobenius digit extraction and root-character identities, followed by the exact Hilbert count. The canonical Cartier interpretation uses omega=dT/product(w_i), so it does not repeat the source-leaving plain Cartier operation. Exact controls compare every reconstructed jet and compatibility kernel in characteristics three and five and preserve the known degree-one failure. For n=6,p=3 the residual size is192, independent of degree; its uniform nonvanishing remains open.
claims.rationale: Provides an exact degree-contracting original-source formulation that resolves a specific Cartier source-change obstacle while preserving the remaining coupled condition. It is a route-specific induction tool, not a new uniform normality family or a pre-stable degree bound.
claims.next_action: Control the actual 192-dimensional compatibility map in dimension six/characteristic three, or show why it cannot improve the existing twenty-row sufficient degeneration.
